lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A repeating grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters (spots) arranged in approximately eight visible vertical columns and five horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance circular clusters, creating a lattice-like grid across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal features exhibit a sharp vertical gradient (high-luminance upper edge, low-luminance lower shadow) running longitudinally across the dorsal-lateral surface.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of approximately 12 high-luminance blobs is visible within the mask of the first dorsal fin, primarily clustered in the ventral-posterior quadrant of the fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated low-luminance silhouettes (remoras) are visible in the ventral water column directly beneath the pectoral fin and midsection.
